text:
maria: Quick sync — onboarding check for `orca-v2-small` before we flip it to canary. Need help validating: weights location, tokenizer oddities, and golden prompt/toolcall smoke.

maria: TL;DR: weights are at s3://redwood-models/onboard/orca-v2-small/weights-v1.tar.gz, tokenizer shows unexpected unknown tokens for zero-width joiners and some emoji sequences, and structured tool-calling outputs need a couple of shape fixes. Can someone pick up config validation + golden eval run? :eyes: @jonah?

jonah: I can take the weights/config validation today. Will confirm checksums and paths. Any specific hashes?

maria: thanks — uploaded with manifest at s3://redwood-models/onboard/orca-v2-small/manifest.json. Expected sha256 in the manifest. Also the model_id in the serving config must be `orca-v2-small:v1`.

jonah: grabbing it. quick grep shows model config in infra repo at `infra/models/orca-v2-small/config.yaml` — looks like max_seq=2048 but the tokenizer was trained with 4096 context. That mismatch worries me.

ashley: FYI — tokenizer behavior I saw in local smoke: when input contains ZWJ (U+200D) some tokens become <unk> and the KV cache index shifts by 1 for subsequent tokens. Repro steps: 
```
# python repro
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
s = 'family\u200d2021'
print(t.encode(s).tokens)
```
This only happened on the on-disk tokenizer we pulled from S3, not in the maven test artifact.

jonah: that explains the context length mismatch note. If tokenizer emits <unk> unexpectedly, we need to ensure `add_bos` and `add_eos` flags match the serving config and update the tokenizer file in the artifact.

kevin: I can run a quick patch: re-save tokenizer with explicit special tokens and run golden prompts to check structured outputs. Which golden set should I use?

maria: use `tests/golden/orca-v2-small/toolcall_set_v1.jsonl` in the model repo. There's a small subset for structured outputs + toolcalling (30 prompts). Put results in `s3://redwood-evals/orca-v2-small/golden-run-<your-uid>/`.

kevin: ok will run now. running eval with: `python -m evals.run --model orca-v2-small:v1 --golden tests/golden/orca-v2-small/toolcall_set_v1.jsonl --out s3://redwood-evals/...`

ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered: infra-models/PR#412 checks started (sha: abc123).

jonah: weights checksum matches manifest, sizes look good. Confirmed the serving config's `max_seq` discrepancy — I'll open a small PR to set serving `max_seq` to 4096 and add a validation step that compares tokenizer.max_len vs serving.max_seq.

ashley: for tokenizer fix I can strip invisible ZWJ where appropriate and normalize emoji sequences to single codepoints. But want to be conservative: will run both patched and unpatched tokenizer against the golden prompts to see diff in toolcall json.

kevin: golden run done (local). Quick findings: 4/30 prompts returned malformed `tool_call` objects (missing `args` array), 2/30 had extra nesting in `result` field. Diff looks like whitespace/serialization mismatch for some outputs — could be a structured output schema drift.

maria: can you paste one example (sanitized)?

kevin: sure — example (sanitized):
```
{
  "prompt_id": "t-012",
  "response": {
    "tool_call": {
      "name": "lookup_stock",
      "args": null,            # expected []
      "result": {"price": "123.45"}
    }
  }
}
```

kevin: serializer on the model side sometimes emits `null` for empty arrays. We need the runtime to coerce null->[] and validate shape before storing.

jonah: I'll add a validation hook in the model adapter layer: if `tool_call.args` is null -> set to []. Also add a schema assert for `result` to be object or null. Will include unit tests.

maria: Awesome. Also we should add a lightweight regression test into the gated preflight — failing if any golden prompt moves structured shape types. That will catch serialization regressions.

ashley: About tokenizer: running patched tokenizer improved outputs — the 4 malformed tool_call cases dropped to 1. Patch reduces <unk> tokens for ZWJ cases. I can push tokenizer update to the artifact if y'all are good with the change.

kevin: +1 from me — but please include a changelog entry in the model artifact and a small note in the serving config about normalization.

maria: agreed. action items: 
- jonah: PR to align serving.max_seq -> 4096 + tokenizer/serving validation hook (PR infra-models#413) (ETA today)
- ashley: push normalized tokenizer to s3 and update artifact + changelog (ETA today)
- kevin: add runtime coercion for `tool_call.args` null->[] + unit tests + add golden regression gate (ETA EOD)
- maria: coordinate canary rollout once PRs merge and golden run passes end-to-end (will ping eng-oncall)

jonah: noted. I'll also run a quick smoke on Dedicated to confirm KV cache indexing unaffected.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued for `orca-v2-small:v1` once all checks pass.

kevin: small FYI — added a lint in serializer to always emit arrays `[]` instead of `null` for empty lists. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/compare/serializer-fix (wip).

maria: perfect. If anyone spots anything else in the golden diffs tag me. I'll close this thread once canary is live. :rocket:

ashley: quick note — added a tiny repro gist for ZWJ: https://gist.github.com/shash/zwj-repro — might help later.

maria: thanks all — super helpful.

kevin: one last check — make sure the model card notes the tokenizer normalization change so downstream users don't get surprising tokenization differences.

maria: yep will update model card in the artifact and call it out in release notes.

jonah: PRs opened: infra-models#413, serving#899. Linking in PR comments to this thread.

maria: nice work team — moving to async follow-ups. will ping if canary fails. :+1:
